units.source_text: 我們倆在銀座四丁目下車，仗著常子的關係，身無分文地走進了那家所謂酒池肉林的咖啡酒吧，

en.t: The two of us got off at Ginza Yonchome and, relying on Tsuneko's connection, walked penniless into that so-called den of wine and women,

units.source_text: 在一間空包廂裡與堀木面對面坐下，屁股還沒坐穩，

en.t: then sat down facing Horiki in an empty booth, and before we had even settled into our seats,

units.source_text: 常子和另一個女服務員便跑過來，那名女服務員坐我身邊，

en.t: Tsuneko and another waitress came running over, and the other waitress sat beside me,

units.source_text: 常子則倏地緊挨著堀木坐了下來。

en.t: while Tsuneko suddenly sat down close beside Horiki.

units.source_text: 我心頭一驚，心想常子就要被堀木親吻了。

en.t: I was startled, thinking that Horiki was about to kiss Tsuneko.

units.source_text: 我沒有一點惋惜的心情。

en.t: I did not feel the slightest regret.

units.source_text: 我這個人本來就沒有太強的佔有慾，

en.t: I had never had much of a possessive instinct to begin with,

units.source_text: 而且，就算隱隱覺得於心不忍，

en.t: and even if I felt a faint twinge of reluctance,

units.source_text: 也沒膽量強調自己的所有權，也沒有精力去與人抗爭。

en.t: I had neither the courage to assert my claim nor the energy to struggle against anyone.
